Being a TechNet customer means supporting a local business, while enjoying the benefits of a nationwide network, like a 24 month/24,000 mile Warranty, Roadside Assistance and Road Hazard Protection. | Services | Aside from your regularly scheduled maintenance, we handle all kinds of cars and their own unique issues. Every car runs and works differently, even if they are the same make/model. We are aware of that fact, which is why we look at every vehicle independently from each other. Knowing that every person drives their car differently helps as well so we try to personalize each of our clients' experience with us. Check out our service menu and call us if you have questions or concerns not mentioned on our website. | General Maintenance | Every car requires regular maintenance. We provide all your regular maintenance services including oil changes, mileage/time-based services and inspections, brake jobs, fluid exchange services, and more. We will help you maintain your vehicle's new vehicle limited warranty, and ensure years of reliability! We want our clients to love their cars! With that, we will always do our best to let you leave feeling 100% satisfied with your car! | Diagnostics | Diagnosing cars can vary from basic, complex, and time consuming. Whether it's a warm A/C system, annoying light on the dash, a mystery rattle, or something else, our technicians use state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment and follow established diagnostic procedures to solve your mystery quickly and accurately. We encourage you to schedule an appointment so we can help you determine the cause of your problem, and get your car in tip top shape! | Mechanical Repairs | As an auto repair shop, our duty is to provide a service in which we keep our customers safe in their cars and on the roads. Not everyone is mechanically inclined, but we are and we're here to take care of your vehicles. Our technicians take pride in providing quality repairs to keep our clients' cars safe and reliable. When you trust us with your vehicle, we'll treat it like our own (or better)! | GENERAL MAINTENANCE | Oil and Filter Services | We provide oil and filter services starting at $49.99 (before tax). All services include a complimentary multi-point inspection! | Fluid Exchange Services | All fluids in your vehicle wear over time, and lose their effectiveness. At Hugo's, we are happy to provide fluid exchange services on all vehicle fluids, and can advise you on your vehicle manufacturer's recommendations. | Factory Scheduled Maintenance | All vehicle manufacturers recommend more than just oil changes to keep your vehicle in optimal condition. From a basic visual inspection to a major service, we can advise you on what is due and perform all services per your manufacturer's suggested schedule. | Battery Testing and Replacement | The harsh operating conditions found in newer vehicles take a toll on your starting and charging system. If your car is getting harder to start, it may be time to replace your worn out battery. We will test your battery, and let you know when replacement is due. | Brake Maintenance and Repair | Just as important as going forward is stopping when you need to. If your brakes don't feel as good as they used to or are starting to make noise, we are here to help! | Tune-Ups | Modern automobiles might not require tune-ups as often, but they still play a vital role in your vehicle's efficiency and reliability. If your car is running a bit rough in the morning, or a gallon of gas just isn't making is as far as it used to, we can advise you of what you need! | DIAGNOSTICS | HVAC | Heating & A/C Diagnostics | Here in Florida, air conditioning is a necessity, especially inside your vehicle. At Hugo's, we can provide diagnostic services for your A/C system and solutions to get your car cool again for the usual hot Florida weather! (And for that very brief winter, we can fix your heat too!) | ELECTRICAL | Electrical Diagnosis | As cars become more and more complex, the electrical system plays an ever-increasing part in your vehicle's operation, and provides more things that can malfunction over time. From a blown fuse to a pesky rodent to a failing switch or relay, we welcome the challenge! | NOISES | Noise Diagnosis | You know when something is not right in your car. Maybe it's a new squeak or rattle, or a vibration that just doesn't seem right. We tackle noises and vibrations with manufacturer-established diagnostic processes, and relentlessly pursue the root cause. | MECHANICAL REPAIRS | Engine Assembly > Drive Train | ENGINE MOUNTS, OIL LEAKS, COOLING SYSTEM LEAKS AND MALFUNCTIONS, TIMING BELTS AND CHAINS, ENGINE REPLACEMENT, INTERNAL ENGINE REPAIRS, WATER PUMPS AND THERMOSTATS, DRIVE BELTS, RADIATORS AND HOSES, AND MORE! | Chassis | SUSPENSION BUSHINGS AND CONTROL ARMS, BRAKE SYSTEM (INCLUDING ABS), SHOCKS AND STRUTS, AIR AND HYDRAULIC SUSPENSION COMPONENTS | Interior | WINDOW MOTORS AND REGULATORS, SUNROOF COMPONENTS, SEAT AND UPHOLSTERY, INTERIOR TRIM, CARPET, AND MORE | HVAC | HEATER HOSES, A/C COMPRESSORS, EVAPORATORS, CONDENSERS, ETC. A/C SYSTEM RECHARGING AND FLUSHING SERVICES | MORE SERVICES WE PROVIDE | In addition to repairs and diagnosis, we also offer inspections for basic safety, pre/post-purchase, and pre-trip. For a small charge, we will inspect your car or truck from above and below, and provide you with a comprehensive assessment of your vehicle's condition and cost of repairs. We strongly encourage anyone looking at used cars to call and take advantage of our services to prevent unpleasant surprises after you sign on the dotted line for your "new" car. | Hugo's Auto Service | dan@hugosauto.com | (352) 373-8247 | 2027 NE 27th Ave, Gainesville, FL 32609 | ©2022 by Hugo's Auto Service.
